visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women are seated on the wooden deck of a moving boat. The woman on the left has short, vibrant pink hair and is wearing a red dress with puffed sleeves and dark sunglasses. The woman on the right has long light-brown hair, wearing a red spaghetti-strap dress, large sunglasses, and holding a smartphone. Behind them, a vast body of blue water leads to high, dark mountains under a bright, high-positioned sun that creates a strong glare and shimmering reflections on the water surface. (2) As the boat continues its motion, both women pose playfully. The pink-haired woman pouts her lips and tilts her head back slightly, while the other woman smiles, adjusts her sunglasses with her hand, and looks towards the camera. The wind is visibly blowing through their hair and the woman's dress straps. White text subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) They shift positions, leaning their heads closer together in a friendly gesture. The sunlight remains intense, casting sharp shadows on their faces and the boat's interior. They continue to interact with the camera with pouts and smiles, maintaining a high-energy, cheerful demeanor throughout the sequence until the end.
